notes.title: Patch no2
notes.content:
Hi there, small patch today addressing some minor issues.


- Fixed Collision on shower 
- Fixed corrupted police car not being able to kill you
- Added pause and exit to menu with backspace

notes.title: First patch is out, here are the patch notes.
notes.content:
- Fixed ''It'' not being able to catch you in the forest level.
- Fixed collision on police doors
- Fixed material on void police car
- Added basic controls layout to boot menu
- Fixed story subtitle not appearing on secondary ending's title screen.
